changelog:
- Initial release of antigravity-image-gen skill.
- Generate high-quality images using the internal Google Antigravity API (Gemini 3 Pro Image) with native, direct integration.
- No browser automation required—works via direct API calls with OAuth credentials.
- Supports custom prompts, output image paths, and aspect ratios.
- Prints the generated image file path for automatic detection and display.
summary: Generate images using the internal Google Antigravity API (Gemini 3 Pro Image). High quality, native generation without browser automation.
